feature_configuration.word_ngrams: 1-2, min_df=2, max_features=60000, used only in word+character model

validation_strategy.timestamp_limitation: source has no per-URL observation time

test_strategy: Untouched registrable-domain-disjoint partition; selected model and threshold were fixed before final test scoring.

selected_thresholds.selection_rule: No model met both validation FPR constraints; selected by validation PR-AUC then F1. Final test and hard-negative test domains are excluded from selection.
selected_thresholds.structural_severity_guard: MALICIOUS requires two independent structural signals; otherwise high probability remains SUSPICIOUS.

hard_negative_metrics.note: Held-out challenge URLs are manually curated or mined from UCI legitimate rows; descriptive only, not used for fit or threshold/model selection.

indicators: URL contains security/account terms: account, login, payment, secure, verify.

baseline_on_same_final_test.note: Existing artifact evaluated on the same final test, after candidate selection; this result was not used for selection.

latency_and_size.selection_rule: maximum validation recall among 0.30–0.90 thresholds with FPR <= 0.02; ties prefer F1 then the higher threshold
latency_and_size.latency_includes: URL feature extraction and single-row model prediction
